question: Who became the first Indian athlete to be nominated for the Laureus World Comeback of the Year Award in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vinesh Phogat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vinesh Phogat__ is the first Indian athlete to be nominated in one of the seven main categories at the Laureus World Sports Awards 2019 edition. 
 
• She is a wrestler from Haryana who made a sensational comeback to win the Asian Games gold medal after a long and testing battle with an injury she had sustained during the quarter-final of 50 kg freestyle wrestling event at the 2016 Olympic Games. 
 
• She was nominated alongside Tiger Woods, who won his first tournament in five years and also won the Laureus World Comeback of the Year Award 2019. 
 
• Laureus World Team of the year 2019- France's men Football team
 
• Laureus World Breakthrough of the year 2019- Naomi Osaka, Japan
 
• Laureus World Sportsman of the year 2019- Novac Djokovic
 
• Laureus World Sportswoman of the year 2019- Simone Biles
